title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
abstract: arXiv:2611.26294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.

translated_title: BADAS-3.0：基于单摄像头的实时驾驶感知与规划
translated_abstract: 我们探讨一个驾驶模型在仅使用单个摄像头并满足实时延迟要求的情况下能达到怎样的水平。BADAS-3.0 是一个拥有10亿参数的视频编码器，配有四个小型输出头。仅凭单个前视摄像头两秒的视频，它就能在50毫秒内预测当前车速、刚行驶过的米制路径、碰撞风险评分以及未来6.4秒的六个候选未来轨迹。在给定车辆当前速度的条件下，BADAS-3.0 在五个轨迹基准测试中的 minADE$_6$ 比 34B 参数的 Alpamayo 2 Super 低 44%，而后者需要读取六个摄像头且运行速度慢100倍以上。这一优势来自两个模型均未在训练中见过的摄像头配置；而在两者共享的摄像头配置上，二者表现相当。由于现有基准测试大多只涉及正常驾驶场景，我们新增了两个开环安全基准测试：一个基于真实行车记录仪的碰撞与险情事件，另一个基于 Euro NCAP 测试场景。在这两个测试上，BADAS-3.0 的通过率均高于我们测试的所有已发表规划器。
tldr: BADAS-3.0 仅凭单摄像头即可在50毫秒内实时完成速度、路径、碰撞风险与未来轨迹预测，其轨迹精度比读取六个摄像头、慢100倍的34B模型低44%的minADE，并在新增的行车记录仪碰撞与Euro NCAP两个安全基准上通过率超过所有已发表规划器。
en_tdlr: BADAS-3.0 performs real-time driving perception and planning from a single camera in under 50 ms, achieving 44% lower minADE than the 34B six-camera Alpamayo 2 Super that runs over 100x slower, and surpassing all published planners on two new open-loop safety benchmarks built from real dashcam collisions and Euro NCAP scenarios.
